desc:
Can you survive long enough to escape the cat

Shrink to hide and don't let the Cat in the Hat catch you. 

If you're daring enough collect enough hats to open the portal and escape!

You have very special powers as the Cat in the Hat. Hint: Tap a player after laughing 🤫

The game is in very early stages, new content is coming soon!

Tags: Hide and Seek, Hide N Seek, Hide & Seek, Escape, Survival
